intelligence.title: AI meeting intelligence
intelligence.description: Create and review an evidence-linked recap from the governed transcript, then explicitly publish it to participants.
intelligence.loadErrorDescription: The latest authorized report could not be verified. No report content is shown.

stateDescriptions.UNAVAILABLE: No authorized AI report is available for this meeting.
stateDescriptions.PROCESSING: The governed transcript is being analyzed. Raw transcript content is not stored in the AI runtime.
stateDescriptions.FAILURE: The run stopped without publishing content. A host can retry after checking the governed dependencies.
stateDescriptions.DRAFT: Only authorized reviewers can see this draft. Verify every cited timestamp before deciding.
stateDescriptions.APPROVED: A reviewer approved this version, but participants cannot see it until explicit publication.
stateDescriptions.PUBLISHED: This reviewed version is visible to authorized meeting participants.
stateDescriptions.REJECTED: The draft was rejected and cannot be published.
stateDescriptions.DELETED: The report content has been purged; only governed deletion evidence remains.

generateBlockers.NOT_HOST: Only the organizer or co-host can request an AI draft.
generateBlockers.PROCESSING: Wait for the current analysis run to finish.
generateBlockers.TRANSCRIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE: A governed transcript artifact must be available before analysis.
generateBlockers.CONTENT_PLAN_NOT_AVAILABLE: The current content-plan version could not be verified; generation remains blocked.

intelligence.actionError: The action was not completed. The last server-confirmed report remains unchanged.
intelligence.processing: Analysis is running outside the database transaction under a fenced lease. This view refreshes while the run is active.
intelligence.disclaimerDescription: This report is not an official record until reviewed and published. It never infers an individual's emotion, intent, personality, health, or productivity.
intelligence.evidenceDescription: Every finding is tied to source transcript segments and inherits meeting access, retention, legal-hold, and deletion controls.
intelligence.climateDescription: A meeting-level, transcript-grounded interaction pattern. It is not an emotion, sentiment, personality, or employee-performance score.
intelligence.reviewDescription: Compare the draft with every cited transcript segment before approving or rejecting this version.
intelligence.reviewSeparationNote: Approval records the reviewer and version. Publication is a separate action so a draft is never shared by accident.

reviewers.title: Reviewers and separation of duties
reviewers.description: Assign an eligible meeting participant to verify the AI draft before approval.
reviewers.separationNote: The person who generated the draft cannot review or manage it. Review authority stays separate from publication authority and every change is audited.
reviewers.loadError: Reviewer eligibility could not be verified. No authority was changed.
reviewers.candidateHelp: Only admitted participants who are independent of this draft can be assigned.
reviewers.noEligible: No additional independent participant is currently eligible.
reviewers.actionError: Review authority was not changed. Check eligibility and try again.
reviewers.noActive: No independent reviewer is assigned yet.

intelligence.publishDescription: Publishing makes this exact reviewed version visible to authorized meeting participants.

artifacts.governance: Recording, transcript, summary, chat, and attendance evidence each have independent access, retention, and deletion evidence.
artifacts.processingRefresh: An artifact is still processing. This recap refreshes automatically while processing continues.
artifacts.retrievalUnavailable: Direct access is limited to supported recordings with a verified retention window. Other stored evidence remains protected and cannot be opened from this screen.

access.opened: Secure playback opened in a new tab. This access expires {{time}}.
access.retentionExpired: The retention period ended. Playback access is no longer available.
access.unverified: Playback remains blocked because media type or retention could not be verified.

content.title: Recording, transcript, and AI notice
content.description: This status comes from the governed meeting content plan and refreshes while the meeting is live.
content.loading: Verifying the current recording and processing plan
content.loadError: The current recording and processing plan could not be verified. Joining and recording controls remain blocked until it is available.
content.refreshErrorLastKnown: The latest content status could not be refreshed. The state below is the last server-confirmed value; recording controls remain blocked.

plan.title: Host content plan
plan.description: Choose what this meeting may capture and process. The server applies tenant policy, consent, and infrastructure checks before anything starts.
plan.recordingDescription: Create an encrypted recording under the tenant retention policy.
plan.transcriptionDescription: Send approved meeting audio to the configured speech-to-text service.
plan.aiSummaryDescription: Create an AI-assisted recap from the governed transcript. Enabling this also enables transcription.
plan.e2eeDescription: Keep media inaccessible to server-side capture and processing services.
plan.e2eeConflict: End-to-end encryption is incompatible with server recording, transcription, and AI summary. Saving this combination keeps processing blocked until the plan is changed.
plan.activeLocked: Stop the active recording request before changing this content plan.
plan.saveSuccess: The server saved the plan and re-evaluated its notice and readiness. Review the current state and notice on this panel.
plan.saveError: The content plan was not saved. The latest server version is being refreshed; review it before trying again.

content.noticeRequiredTitle: Review and acknowledge this meeting notice
content.noticeAcknowledgedTitle: You acknowledged the current meeting notice
content.noticeDescription: Notice revision {{revision}} covers the enabled recording, transcript, and AI processing shown above.
content.noticeUnavailable: Processing was requested, but the authoritative disclosure notice is unavailable. Joining and recording stay blocked.
content.acknowledgeError: The notice could not be acknowledged. Refresh the current revision and try again.
content.startBlocked: Recording starts only when the plan is ready, every required acknowledgement is present, and the meeting is live.
content.commandError: The recording command was not accepted. Review the current blockers before trying again.
content.startConfirmDescription: Recording starts only for the disclosed content plan. All participants will continue to see the server-authoritative recording state.
content.stopConfirmDescription: The service will finalize the recording under the configured retention and access policy.

operations.description: Monitor active demand and service quality without exposing meeting content.
operations.privacy: Operations metrics contain service metadata only. Meeting content is not displayed here.

policy.title: Meeting policy
policy.description: Apply tenant defaults for access, content, capacity, and retention.
policy.meetingsEnabledHint: Make video meetings available to tenant members.
policy.waitingRoomHint: Every participant enters after host approval.
policy.authenticatedInternalHint: Company members must join with a verified DWP account.
policy.chatHint: Allow participants to exchange text messages during meetings.
policy.reactionsHint: Enable non-verbal feedback without interrupting the meeting.
policy.screenShareHint: Allow presenters to share a screen during meetings.
policy.recordingUnavailable: LiveKit Egress is not configured. Recording cannot be enabled.
policy.recordingHostOptInHint: Allow hosts to request governed recording after participant notice and consent.
policy.recordingHostOptInWarning: Host opt-in permits only a governed recording request. Recording still remains unavailable unless the readiness view verifies Egress, encrypted storage, key management, audit, and retention execution.
policy.recordingAdminRequiredHint: Tenant administrators require governed recording for eligible meetings. This inherited policy is preserved until explicitly changed.
policy.recordingAdminRequiredWarning: Administrator-required recording remains subject to visible notice, consent, and every runtime readiness control. Saving unrelated policy fields does not change this inherited policy.
policy.aiNotesUnavailable: The governed AI notes provider is not configured.
policy.chatRetentionHint: Set 0 to retain messages only while the meeting is live. Enter 0–365 days without exceeding meeting record retention ({{meetingRetentionDays}} days).
policy.chatRetentionRangeError: Enter a whole number from 0 to 365.
policy.chatRetentionMeetingError: Meeting chat retention cannot exceed meeting record retention.
policy.artifactRetentionMeetingError: Meeting artifact retention cannot exceed meeting record retention.
policy.unmuteRequestOnly: Hosts cannot unmute participants directly; they can only request that participants unmute themselves.
policy.saveError: Meeting policy could not be saved.

intelligence.title: AI and data governance
intelligence.description: Verify which meeting intelligence capabilities are actually ready and which operational controls still block release.
intelligence.accessBoundary: This administration view exposes policy and dependency status only. It never grants access to recordings, transcripts, chats, or AI report content.

sourceErrors.readiness: Authoritative intelligence readiness could not be verified. All runtime controls remain fail-closed.
sourceErrors.policy: Tenant policy could not be refreshed. Runtime readiness remains independently visible.

intelligence.capabilitiesDescription: A capability is ready only when tenant policy, governed processing, and runtime dependencies agree.
intelligence.dependenciesDescription: Production endpoints, regional controls, encryption, audit, and processors must be independently verified.
intelligence.workflowDescription: AI output remains a draft until an authorized reviewer verifies the evidence and explicitly publishes it.
intelligence.lifecycleDescription: Content access, legal hold, expiry, deletion, and immutable evidence are evaluated separately.
intelligence.retentionDescription: Artifact and chat retention must remain within the meeting record boundary.

reasons.CAPABILITY_NOT_CONFIGURED: The runtime does not report this capability as configured.
reasons.CAPABILITY_NOT_READY: One or more governed runtime requirements are not ready.
reasons.MEETINGS_DISABLED_BY_POLICY: Video meetings are disabled by tenant policy.
reasons.MEETING_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The meeting media provider is unavailable.
reasons.REALTIME_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The realtime media provider is unavailable.
reasons.PROCESSING_REGION_NOT_VERIFIED: The managed processing region is not verified.
reasons.AUDIT_NOT_READY: Immutable audit delivery is not ready.
reasons.EGRESS_NOT_READY: Governed recording Egress is not ready.
reasons.STORAGE_NOT_READY: Encrypted artifact storage is not ready.
reasons.STT_NOT_READY: The approved speech-to-text processor is not ready.
reasons.LLM_NOT_READY: The approved managed language model is not ready.
reasons.LLM_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_NOT_READY: No successful tenant-bound run verifies this provider, model, and region within the last 24 hours.
reasons.RETENTION_WORKER_NOT_READY: Retention execution and deletion evidence are not ready.
reasons.INTELLIGENCE_REPORT_RETENTION_NOT_READY: AI report purge execution and database evidence are not ready.
reasons.MEETING_RECORD_RETENTION_WORKER_NOT_CONF: Meeting-record purge execution is not implemented or verified.
reasons.ARTIFACT_RETENTION_WORKER_NOT_CONFIGURED: Recording and transcript purge execution is not implemented or verified.
reasons.CHAT_RETENTION_WORKER_NOT_CONFIGURED: Meeting-chat purge execution is not implemented or verified.
reasons.COMPLETE_DELETION_EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED: Deletion evidence is incomplete across meeting records, artifacts, chats, and AI reports.
reasons.DEPENDENCY_STATUS_CONTRACT_MISSING: No authoritative dependency readiness contract is connected.
reasons.WORKFLOW_ENFORCEMENT_NOT_VERIFIED: Server-side review and publication enforcement is not verified.
reasons.LEGAL_HOLD_ADMIN_WORKFLOW_NOT_CONFIGURED: The authorized legal-hold administration workflow is not configured.
reasons.DELETION_EVIDENCE_NOT_READY: Deletion execution and immutable evidence are not ready.
reasons.DELETION_EVIDENCE_NOT_CONNECTED: Deletion execution and evidence are not connected.
reasons.RUNTIME_SIGNAL_MISSING: The readiness response omitted this required runtime signal.
reasons.READINESS_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE: Authoritative runtime readiness could not be verified.
